items.title: John Pope Interview, 1959-05-01
items.q: And, of course, he was one of the late members, you know. He just trained him myself.

ctx.x: Bolero, like a Spanish name. Bolero, yes. And, of course, he was one of the late members, you know. He just trained him myself. He'd come along and go every day, you know. But my father practically gives it up.

There was one musician I was going to ask about. I met a male man downtown this morning who is a musician too. And he told me there was a fellow, he didn't know his real name, they just call him Chicken. And he's a jazz at the cathedral.
